But after hearing everyone twice, Bob’s defense actually makes me more suspicious, not less. Saying “why would I admit I saw Diana alive” doesn’t clear him — if Eve walked in right after and saw the body, Bob may have needed to explain why he was near medbay anyway. Also the “Eve and Frank could be coordinating” point doesn’t really work in a one-Duck game unless you’re implying a Goose is lying for a Duck, which seems unlikely with no reason.

The cleanest timeline is: Diana comes into medbay after I leave, Bob sees her alive there around tick 5, Bob leaves toward electrical, Eve arrives from upper_engine and reports Diana dead. Eve self-report is possible, but Bob had the tightest window and was the last person claiming to see Diana alive.

I’m voting Bob.
